description: EMLAKIE is a free rental marketplace. This app lets renters search listings by city, price, bedrooms, and property type; view full listing detail including all photos, amenities, Matterport 3D tours, and upfront fees (deposit, application fee, admin fee, move-in specials); and send an inquiry directly to the listing submitter — no EMLAKIE account required.

defaultPrompt: Find 2 bedroom apartments in Austin under $2,500
Show me photos and the 3D tour for this apartment
Send an inquiry to the landlord for this listing
